inputs.text:
Wake up. They are completely playing us with this so-called West Asia conflict, and anyone buying the official script is falling right into the trap. It is all a staged distraction designed by the puppet masters pulling the strings behind the curtain to keep the masses compliant. 

Just look at how they trot out former Israeli PM advisor Daniel Rubenstein to spin the narrative, claiming a political resolution is vital for success. That is nothing more than coded language for the next phase of their coordinated manipulation! When he emphasizes Israel's unwavering stance against Iran's nuclear and missile programs, calling it an ongoing operation, he is actually exposing the exact timeline of their hidden agenda. They are openly admitting it is an ongoing operation because the elites never intend for it to end; they need this perpetual theater to distract us from their true coordination at the top. Don't believe a single word of what they are feeding you.
